title: CI: Skip desktop builds when semantic release publishes no release
description:
Desktop build jobs sometimes fail with a 404 when attaching assets to a release tag (e.g. v0.42.0) on commits that did not actually publish a new GitHub Release.

Observed failure pattern:
- Build Desktop Apps (ubuntu-latest) -> softprops/action-gh-release upload returns 404

Root cause:
- desktop-builds derives tag via `git describe --tags --abbrev=0`, and runs after the release job even when semantic-release did not publish a new release.

Fix:
- Have the release job compute outputs (released true/false, tag, version) based on whether a new tag was created.
- Gate desktop-builds on `needs.release.outputs.released == 'true'`.
- Checkout the release tag and use the propagated version/tag outputs.

Acceptance:
- Desktop builds do not run on main pushes that do not publish a new release.
- No more 404s when attaching assets due to missing/mismatched release.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_close_reason: Release workflow now outputs released/tag/version and gates desktop builds; desktop job checks out release tag
